correctness.rationale: Reconstructed marked Poisson point process after jump transform r=Gamma^(-1/alpha): direction-j mass tail w_n yields independent positive-alpha-stable R_n with Laplace exp(-w_n Gamma(1-alpha)t^alpha). For q in (0,alpha), E R_n^q=K w_n^(q/alpha), and geometric w_n<=C rho^n plus Markov and Borel-Cantelli gives almost-sure exponentially small R_n. For generic normals the support sum is unique; truncations take at most 2 sum_{k=0}^{d-1} binom(n-1,k) finite hyperplane chambers, and the finite CLOSED-ball covering passes to closure of exposed points and hence all extreme points by Straszewicz. Thus N_r<=C(1+log 1/r)^(d-1). Dense positive-mass directions ensure d-dimensional interior and injectivity of the exposed-point support map on a continuum of generic normals. Quantifiers, samplewise constants and all d>=2,0<alpha<1 checked; no finite approximation used as infinite proof.
